points.description: States one valid advantage of Industry 4.0 (e.g., higher quality products with minimal human intervention, faster production using smart machines/advanced technology, or efficient processes with lower cost per piece, less wasted raw material).
points.partial_credit: Half if the advantage is vague (e.g., just 'better' or 'automation') but on the right track.

points.description: States a second, different valid advantage of Industry 4.0 (any of the ideas above: quality, less human intervention, time saving, cost efficiency, less material waste).
points.partial_credit: Half if vague but on the right track.

rubric.notes: Full marks for two distinct advantages in any wording, such as better quality, less human effort, faster production, lower cost, or less waste. Give part marks for a vague or only partly correct advantage. Give no marks for wrong or unrelated points. Two wordings of the same idea count as one advantage.
